title: fast_tests.py --changed, low priority and half the cores by default
description: Timed wave of 2026-11-17: 4 agents each running the full suite at once saturated 10 cores; each run took 2 to 4 min instead of 55 s, and the Mac became unusable. Agents will now run only the tests their change touches.
acceptance_criteria: --changed selects the test files affected by the working-tree diff against HEAD (git diff --name-only plus untracked files): every changed test file, and every test file that imports or names a changed module under .harness/bin or examples/ (a static scan of import lines and of the module's file name in the test source). Print the selection and why each file was picked. A change to a file no test references selects nothing and says so; it never falls back silently to the full suite.
--changed accepts --base REF to diff against another commit.

Children run at low priority (os.nice, default 10, flag --nice) and the machine-wide slot cap defaults to half the cores (env HARNESS_TEST_SLOTS overrides it; -j cannot exceed it). Document both in the module docstring.

Tests in .harness/tests/test_fast_tests.py, in throwaway git repos: a changed bin module selects the test that imports it and not an unrelated one; a changed test file selects itself; an unreferenced change selects nothing; the slot cap honours the env var.
Edit fast_tests.py and the new test file only. Run only the tests your change touches. Hand off to verifier.

notes.note: plan: --changed (git diff + untracked, static import/name scan), --base, --nice via os.nice in the runner (children inherit), slot cap = half cores with HARNESS_TEST_SLOTS, -j clamped; tests in throwaway git repos

HANDOFF -> verifier: fast_tests.py: --changed (git diff vs HEAD + untracked; static import-line and file-name scan over .harness/bin and examples; prints each pick with its reason; nothing selected says so and exits 5, never the full suite), --base REF, --nice (default 10, applied once in the runner so children inherit), slot cap = half the cores with HARNESS_TEST_SLOTS override, -j clamped to it; docstring updated. New .harness/tests/test_fast_tests.py: 27 passed in throwaway git repos; 7 mutants killed in a tempfile copy. Ran only test_fast_tests.py.

VERDICT done. Replayed: test_fast_tests.py 27 passed; 9 own mutants in a tempfile copy all caught (name scan off, import scan off, test not self-picking, fallback to full suite, cap = all cores, nice default 0, env var ignored, base fixed to HEAD, bad base swallowed). Live: bad base exits 2, --changed with --serial refused. Docstring documents nice and the slot cap. Limitation, not a defect against the spec: the scan is static, so a change to harness_common.py or portalock.py (imported by most bin modules) does not select tests that reach them only through blackboard, attest, roster and the like. Follow-up suggestion: a one-level transitive import closure over bin modules.
